content: दिश् €6 <ab>U.</ab> (दिशति-ते, दिष्ट; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} दिदिक्षति-ते) .²1 To point out, show, exhibit, produce (as a witness); साक्षिणः सन्ति मेत्युक्त्वा दिशेत्युक्तो दिशेन्न यः <ls>Ms. 8. 57</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">52</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">53</ls>. .²2 To assign, allot; इष्टां गतिं तस्य सुरा दिशन्ति <ls>Mb.</ls> .²3 To give, grant, bestow upon, deliver or make over to; बाणमत्रभवते निजं दिशन् <ls>Ki. 13. 68</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 30</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 2</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 72</ls>. .²4 To pay (as tribute). .²5 To consent to; मृत्यभाविं दुहितुः परिग्रहाद्दिश्यतां कुलमिदं निमेरिति <ls>R. 11. 49</ls>. .²6 To direct, order, command. .²7 To allow, permit; स्मर्तुं दिशन्ति न दिवः सुरसुन्दरीभ्यः <ls>Ki. 5. 28</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (देशयति-ते) .²1 To show, point out, allot, assign. .²2 To teach, communicate, tell, inform. .²3 To direct, order. .²4 To confer, bestow.

दिश् {%f.%} [दिशति ददात्यवकाशं दिश्-क्विप्] (<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> दिक्ग्) .²1 A direction, cardinal point, point of the compass, quarter of the sky; दिशः प्रसेदुर्मरुतो ववुः सुखाः <ls>R. 3. 14</ls>; दिशि दिशि किरति सजलकणजालम् <ls>Gīt. 4</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) The mere direction of a thing, hint, indication (of the general lines); इति दिक् (often used by commentators <ab>&c.</ab>); इत्थं लौकिकशब्दानां दिङ्मात्रमिह दर्शितम् <ls>Sk.</ls> .³({%b%}) (Hence) Mode, manner, method; मुनेः पाठोक्तदिशा <ls>S. D.</ls>; दिगियं सूत्रकृता प्रदर्शितादासीसभं नृपसभं रक्षःसभमिमा दिशः <ls>Ak.</ls> .²3 Region, space, place in general. .²4 A foreign or distant region. .²5 A point of view, manner of considering a subject. .²6 A precept, order. .²7 The number ‘ten’. .²8 A side or party. .²9 The mark of a bite. ‘दिग्दष्टे वर्तुलाकारे करिका नखरेखिका’ इति वैजयन्ती; परिणतदिक्करिकास्तटीर्बिभर्ति <ls>Śi. 4. 29</ls>. [<ab>N. B.</ab> In <ab>comp.</ab> दिश् becomes दिग् before words beginning with vowels and soft consonants, and दिक् before words beginning with hard consonants; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} दिगम्बर, दिग्गज, दिक्पथ, दिक्करिन्, <ab>&c.</ab>]
